stops.title: Sɛvis dɛn
stops.caption: Ɛvri gadarin, ɛn in rɛjista.
stops.speech: Atɛndans de lis di sɛvis dɛn. Ɛvri wan de sho omɔch dɛn rɛkɔd ɛn if di rɛjista stil opin.

stops.title: Rɛkɔd Udat Kam
stops.caption: Di dɛsk, ɔ di mɛmba insɛf.
stops.speech: Opin wan sɛvis fɔ mak pipul prɛzɛnt, let ɔ vɔchwal. Mɛmba kin chɛk dɛnsɛf in wit di QR kod na di dɔ.
